entities.name: CTP synthase (query)
observations: 543-aa sequence; predicted mass 59.8 kDa and theoretical pI 5.44.
Strong full-length homology to curated bacterial CTP synthases (78.1% identity, 100% query coverage).
Contains Pfam CTP_synth_N domain at residues 3–265 and GATase domain at residues 302–534.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia; pathway role is de novo pyrimidine/CTP biosynthesis.
Curated homologs are annotated as homotetramers and cytosolic; these properties are transferred from homolog evidence, not directly measured for query.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: CTP synthase catalyzes the final amination step, converting UTP to CTP using ATP and a nitrogen source.
